python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
counts = {}
for directory in ("app", "collectors", "inference", "ml", "scripts", "tests"):
    paths = list(Path(directory).rglob("*.py"))
    for path in paths:
        ast.parse(path.read_text(), filename=str(path))
    counts[directory] = len(paths)
seen = set()
def visit(path):
    if path in seen:
        return
    assert path.is_file(), str(path)
    seen.add(path)
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith("-r "):
            visit(path.parent / line[3:].strip())
visit(Path("requirements.txt"))
visit(Path("requirements-dev.txt"))
assert "COPY --chown=user requirements*.txt ./" in Path("Dockerfile").read_text()
compose = yaml.safe_load(Path("docker-compose.yml").read_text())
assert len(compose["services"]) == 8
links = 0
for name in ("README.md", "docs/course/inference/README.md", "docs/course/containers/README.md", "docs/course/containers/verification.md"):
    path = Path(name)
    for link in re.findall(r"\]\(([^\s)]+)\)", path.read_text()):
        if "://" in link or link.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if name == "README.md" and not link.startswith("docs/course/containers/"):
            continue
        assert (path.parent / link.split("#")[0]).exists(), (name, link)
        links += 1
blocks = re.findall(r"```bash\n(.*?)```", Path("docs/course/containers/README.md").read_text(), re.S)
embedded = 0
for block in blocks:
    result = subprocess.run(["bash", "-n"], input=block, text=True, capture_output=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    for source in re.findall(r"<<'PY'\n(.*?)\nPY(?:\n|$)", block, re.S):
        ast.parse(source)
        embedded += 1
print(json.dumps(dict(ast_files=counts, requirements=sorted(map(str, seen)), compose_services=len(compose["services"]), markdown_links=links, bash_blocks=len(blocks), embedded_python_blocks=embedded)))
